name: Joseph Murphy Furniture Maker
old_description: Custom furniture featuring pleasing proportions, the highest functionality, and beautiful woods. Handmade in Madison, Wisconsin. Explore my site to learn more.
about:
Joseph Murphy Furniture Maker operates from Madison, Wisconsin, where founder Joe Murphy designs and builds custom furniture. Murphy, a mechanical engineering graduate from the University of Wisconsin–Madison, worked as an engineer at a local manufacturing company before woodworking became his full-time pursuit. He traces the start of his practice to the wood shop at that employer, where he immersed himself in the writings of James Krenov and Japanese tool catalogs before launching his own studio.

The shop produces one-off and small-batch pieces including dining tables, media cabinets, benches, desks, and shadow boxes. Murphy’s process blends traditional hand-tool techniques with modern aids such as a Festool Domino joiner and a Shaper Origin CNC router. Work is carried out in a solo workshop; no facility size or employee count is disclosed, and output is measured in individual commissions rather than volume runs.

Clients are primarily residential customers in the Madison area, as reflected in testimonials from homeowners who commissioned dining nooks, display cabinets, and campaign-button shadow boxes. Murphy’s work has also reached a broader audience through features in Fine Woodworking, Apartment Therapy, and Brava Magazine, and through exhibitions at the Philadelphia Museum of Art Craft Show (where he won the Wharton Esherick Museum prize), the Architectural Digest MADE show in New York, and Madison’s Art Fair on the Square.

Murphy cites his engineering background as a foundation for functional, proportion-driven design. He describes his goal as creating furniture that acts like a “great companion”—pieces with pleasing proportions, subtle curves, and tactile surfaces intended to last for generations rather than follow trends.

name: June Fabrics
old_description: June Fabrics ships to all 50 United States, the U.S. territories, P.O. Boxes and Japan.
about:
June Fabrics is based in Honolulu, Hawaii, and ships fabric orders to all 50 United States, U.S. territories, P.O. boxes, and Japan. The company does not disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or the names of its founders in its public materials.

The business operates as an online fabric retailer, stocking polyester-cotton blends (65% polyester/35% cotton), 100% cotton broadcloth, 100% cotton sheeting, and 100% cotton palaka prints. All listed fabrics are 45 inches wide and priced between $5.00 and $9.00 per unit. Inventory includes patterned designs such as teal, paisley blue, olive/white, pink, white/black, and multiple palaka colorways (black/red, seagreen, UH green, red, beige, purple, ilima yellow, black, avocado, fuchsia). Orders are fulfilled from stock through an e-commerce platform.

The product range serves quilting, apparel, and craft customers, though the company does not explicitly name target industries. Payment is accepted via Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, and PayPal. Customer contact is available by phone at  or email at .

No public statement describes the company's origins or what sets it apart beyond its shipping coverage and fabric selection.

old_description: K&E specializes in custom project orders. From HVAC needs such as roof curbs, curb adapters, equipment stands and more, to ornamental projects such as iron fencing, railing, ladders, etc.
about:
K and E Fabrication, LLC is located at 6401 SE 74th Street in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma. The company operates as a custom metal fabrication shop serving clients throughout the state. Details about its founding year, ownership structure, or founders are not publicly available.

The shop specializes in custom project orders, with a focus on two main product lines: HVAC components and ornamental ironwork. For HVAC systems, it fabricates roof curbs, curb adapters, and equipment stands. On the ornamental side, it produces iron fencing, railings, and ladders. The company describes its capabilities as covering a wide variety of metal products for commercial, industrial, and residential projects.

K and E Fabrication’s customer base spans commercial, industrial, and residential sectors. The company highlights commercial and residential railing projects as well as custom HVAC products for building systems. Its services are marketed across Oklahoma, targeting contractors and project managers who need fabricated metal solutions.

The firm positions itself on experience, craftsmanship, and a determination to pursue all fields of metal fabrication. It emphasizes a drive to handle diverse custom orders rather than standard catalog items.

name: K. Alger Woodworking & Custom Interiors Inc.
old_description: Specializing in custom cabinetry, millwork, woodworking, and installation for residential and commercial projects.
about:
K. Alger Woodworking & Custom Interiors Inc. operates as a specialty contractor in Johnston, Rhode Island. The company is led by owner Ken Alger, who heads a small shop dedicated to custom cabinetry and millwork.

The shop fabricates custom cabinetry, architectural millwork, crown molding, and custom woodworking for residential and commercial projects. Services include design, material takeoffs, fabrication, and installation. The company also provides cabinet refinishing and millwork design services. They work alongside cabinet shops from Maine to New York City.

Clients range from homeowners and designers to general contractors such as V&M Holding Co. The firm serves both residential remodel projects and commercial installations across the Northeast.

The company’s stated mission is “Building legacies through leadership, modern craftsmanship, and unexpected customer care.” Core values emphasize excellence, humility, respect, positive attitude, honesty, pride in performance, and giving more than received. Their philosophy stresses continuous learning from mistakes, respect for skilled design, and a positive team environment.

name: KLA Corporation (Virginia, VA)
old_description: KLA is proud to be part of the Fortune America’s Most Innovative Companies 2026 list
about:
Headquartered in Manassas, Virginia, KLA Corporation operates as a global supplier of process control and yield management solutions for the semiconductor and electronics industries. The company traces its roots to a focus on electron and photon optics, sensor technology, and artificial intelligence, positioning itself at the nexus of raw wafer processing and next-generation chip manufacturing.

KLA develops and manufactures process-control and process-enabling equipment used across the electronics ecosystem, from wafer and reticle inspection to integrated circuit metrology, advanced packaging, and printed circuit board analysis. Its service organization fields over 3,000 field service engineers worldwide and maintains a global supply chain network stocking more than 250,000 parts and subsystems, supporting tool health, upgrades, and remanufactured systems through its KLA Pro Systems line.

The company serves semiconductor manufacturers, foundries, and fabless design houses across automotive, data center, mobile, Internet of Things, and artificial intelligence markets. Its solutions are deployed in fabs producing chips for advanced driver-assistance systems, high-performance computing, 5G infrastructure, and high-bandwidth memory architectures.

KLA emphasizes its role as an extension of customer operations, offering flexible service contracts, certified OEM parts, and technology upgrades that extend tool lifespan and optimize performance for each process node. The company states its mission is to accelerate tomorrow's electronic devices through innovation in inspection, metrology, and analytics.

name: KNEXTEC LLC
old_description: KNEXTEC is a wire harness manufacture and custom cable manufacture located in Las Vegas Nevada
about:
KNEXTEC LLC was founded in 2010 by Wayne Shafer in Las Vegas, Nevada. Virginia Shafer joined as co-founder, and the company established its manufacturing headquarters in Las Vegas with a second production site in Tijuana, Baja California, Mexico.

The company specializes in custom cable assembly and wire harness manufacturing, including design, prototyping, and low-volume production. Its capabilities extend to PCB rework and product upgrades, LED assembly, wire cutting and crimping, heat-shrink cutting, control panel manufacturing, and full box-build services. All products undergo 100% individual testing to IPC-A-610, IPC-7711/7721, and IPC/WHMA-A-620 Revision C standards.

KNEXTEC serves original equipment manufacturers in the gaming industry through its GamingCables.com division, as well as broader contract electronic manufacturing clients requiring high-reliability cable and harness solutions. The company emphasizes fast turnaround on exacting, short-timeline projects regardless of order size.

The founders built the business around a relationship-first philosophy, prioritizing responsive service and quality over project volume. This approach is reflected in their commitment to immediate replacement or repair of any non-conforming product and support for product development and design.

name: KS Woodcraft LLC
old_description: We operate a custom wood furniture shop that specializes in hand crafting Rustic, Modern, Farmhouse and Contemporary wood furniture. We use a variety of solid hardwoods that are domestic and foreign.
about:
KS Woodcraft LLC is a family-owned and operated custom wood furniture shop based in McKinney, Texas, within the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex. The company describes itself as a small business built around handcrafted production, though no founding year or founder names are disclosed publicly.

The shop produces one-of-a-kind tables and furniture pieces in styles that include rustic farmhouse, modern industrial, contemporary, trestle, round, and reclaimed designs. All items are handcrafted from solid domestic hardwoods sourced locally as well as exotic imported species, and the company also works with reclaimed lumber salvaged from the historic McKinney Cotton Mill. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

KS Woodcraft serves residential, commercial, and office clients, inviting local customers to visit the shop for design consultations. The business emphasizes a collaborative process in which the buyer provides input throughout the build, aiming to deliver furniture that fits the exact size, shape, and finish the space requires.

The company positions its work as an alternative to mass‑market retailers that rely on veneers and lower‑grade materials. Its stated motto — “Always make furniture seem like the room was built around it” — reflects a focus on bespoke, heirloom‑quality construction rather than standardized inventory.

name: Kansas Maid Frozen Pastries
old_description: Fundraising With Frozen Pastries for Charities and Non-profit organizations
about:
Kansas Maid Frozen Pastries operates from Madison, Kansas, where it produces frozen pastries for fundraising programs serving non-profit and charitable organizations. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, but it has established a niche in helping groups raise money through pastry sales.

The company manufactures its pastries from scratch in a nut-free facility using 100% real butter and other premium ingredients. Its process supplies fundraising groups with full-color sales brochures; members sell to family, friends, and coworkers, then submit orders for delivery scheduled two to three weeks later. Kansas Maid handles production, packaging, and logistics, allowing groups to keep up to 50% of sales revenue without upfront costs or contractual obligations.

Customers include a wide range of youth and community organizations: 4-H clubs, school bands, cheer and dance teams, church groups, daycares, student travel programs, and youth sports leagues. The model is designed for any non-profit or charity seeking a straightforward product fundraiser with no minimum order requirements.

Kansas Maid emphasizes a low-barrier approach: no contracts, no money down, payment due only upon delivery, and no minimum quantities. The company states its goal is to help each group reach its financial target, differentiating itself through a combination of scratch-made quality, nut-free assurance, and a risk-free fundraising structure.
